theme: 教材片語・中高階 750–850 第 32 群

items.colloc: turn the box on its side 把箱子側放 | lay it on its side 平放側面
items.distinct: turn over 翻轉 | tip over 傾倒
ex: Please turn the heavy box on its side carefully.
請小心地將這個重箱子側放。
You should turn the screen on its side to view.
你應該將螢幕側轉過來檢視。
We decided to turn the table on its side.
我們決定將桌子側放。

items.pos: phr. 求助於；轉向；開始從事
items.colloc: turn to a professional 向專業人士求助 | turn to page ten 翻到第十頁
items.distinct: turn into 變成 | turn off 關掉
ex: Many employees turn to HR for policy clarifications.
許多員工向人資部尋求政策說明。
You should turn to the manual for detailed instructions.
你應該翻閱手冊以獲取詳細指引。
Investors often turn to gold during market instability.
市場不穩時投資人常轉向黃金。

items.pos: phr. 易於使用的；友善的
items.colloc: user friendly interface 友善介面 | user friendly design 易用設計
items.distinct: easy to use 容易使用 | consumer friendly 消費者友善
ex: The new software interface is very user friendly.
這套新軟體介面非常容易使用。
We need a more user friendly booking system.
我們需要一套更易於操作的預訂系統。
This device is designed to be user friendly.
這款裝置的設計旨在簡便易用。

items.colloc: book a vacation package 預訂套裝行程 | affordable vacation package 實惠套裝行程
items.distinct: travel agency 旅行社 | tour group 旅遊團
ex: Our company offers an affordable vacation package.
我們公司提供經濟實惠的度假套裝行程。
Please check the details of your vacation package.
請核對您的度假套裝行程細節。
They purchased a vacation package for their anniversary.
他們購買了一套週年紀念度假行程。

items.colloc: valid for one year 有效期一年 | valid for all members 適用於所有會員
items.distinct: be available for 可用於 | be eligible for 有資格獲得
ex: This membership card is valid for two years.
這張會員卡有效期為兩年。
The discount coupon is valid for online purchases.
這張折價券適用於線上購物。
The offer is valid for a limited time only.
此優惠僅在有限時間內有效。

items.colloc: leather watch band 皮革錶帶 | replace the watch band 更換錶帶
items.distinct: watch face 錶面 | watch case 錶殼
ex: I need to replace my broken watch band.
我需要更換損壞的錶帶。
This store sells a variety of leather watch bands.
這家店販售多款皮革錶帶。
The technician adjusted the length of the watch band.
技術人員調整了錶帶的長度。

items.colloc: check the weather report 查看天氣預報 | inaccurate weather report 不準確的天氣預報
items.distinct: weather forecast 天氣預測 | climate change 氣候變遷
ex: I checked the weather report before the business trip.
出差前我查詢了天氣預報。
The weather report warns of a heavy storm.
天氣預報警告有強烈風暴。
The morning weather report indicates clear skies today.
早晨的天氣預報顯示今天天氣晴朗。

items.colloc: when it comes to marketing 談到行銷 | when it comes to business 關於生意
items.distinct: as for 至於 | regarding 關於
ex: He is an expert when it comes to finance.
談到財務，他是個專家。
When it comes to customer service, we prioritize quality.
關於顧客服務，我們優先重視品質。
She is very picky when it comes to design.
談到設計，她非常挑剔。

items.colloc: win a design contest 贏得設計比賽 | win a sales contest 贏得銷售競賽
items.distinct: win a prize 贏得獎項 | participate in a contest 參加比賽
ex: Our team managed to win a sales contest.
我們的團隊設法贏得了銷售競賽。
She was thrilled to win a photography contest.
她對於贏得攝影比賽感到興奮。
Many employees hope to win a contest this year.
許多員工希望今年能贏得競賽。

items.pos: n. 看櫥窗購物（只逛不買）
items.colloc: enjoy window shopping 享受逛街樂趣 | go window shopping 去逛街看看
items.distinct: shopping spree 瘋狂購物 | online shopping 線上購物
ex: We decided to go window shopping after lunch.
午餐後我們決定去逛逛櫥窗。
They spent the afternoon window shopping in the mall.
他們下午在商場逛街看櫥窗。
Window shopping is a relaxing way to spend time.
逛櫥窗是一種輕鬆的打發時間方式。

items.pos: n. 工作經歷；工作資歷
items.colloc: detailed work history 詳細工作經歷 | review work history 審閱工作經歷
items.distinct: employment record 就業紀錄 | resume 履歷表
ex: Please provide a detailed work history in your resume.
請在履歷中提供詳細的工作經歷。
The recruiter carefully reviewed his work history.
招募人員仔細審閱了他的工作經歷。
Your work history is impressive for this position.
以這個職位來說，你的工作經歷相當亮眼。

items.colloc: a complete line of products 一系列產品 | a complete line of services 一系列服務
items.distinct: a range of 一系列範圍 | a variety of 各式各樣
ex: The company offers a complete line of office supplies.
該公司提供一整系列的辦公用品。
We carry a complete line of professional kitchen equipment.
我們販售一整系列的專業廚房設備。
They are launching a complete line of new software.
他們正推出一整系列的新軟體。

items.colloc: a great deal of time 大量時間 | a great deal of effort 許多努力
items.distinct: a large number of 大量的（可數）| a great amount of 大量的（不可數）
ex: The project required a great deal of research.
該專案需要大量的研究。
She spent a great deal of time on this report.
她花費了大量的時間在報告上。
Success requires a great deal of hard work.
成功需要大量的辛勤工作。

items.pos: phr. 接受邀請；接受報價
items.colloc: accept the job offer 接受工作錄取 | accept the price offer 接受報價
items.distinct: decline the offer 拒絕邀請 | consider the offer 考慮報價
ex: I am happy to accept the job offer.
我很高興接受這份工作錄取。
They decided to accept the offer from the vendor.
他們決定接受該廠商的報價。
She needed time to consider whether to accept the offer.
她需要時間考慮是否接受該邀請。

items.colloc: all the way to the office 一路到辦公室 | support him all the way 全力支持他
items.distinct: the whole way 整個路程 | throughout 自始至終
ex: He drove all the way to the headquarters.
他一路開車前往總部。
Our team will support the new initiative all the way.
我們的團隊將全力支持這項新措施。
The train goes all the way to the city center.
這班火車一路開到市中心。

items.pos: phr. 各行各業；社會各界
items.colloc: people from all walks of life 來自各行各業的人 | representing all walks of life 代表各界
items.distinct: every industry 每個產業 | various backgrounds 各種背景
ex: The event attracted people from all walks of life.
該活動吸引了來自各行各業的人們。
Our product is used by professionals from all walks of life.
我們的產品被各行各業的專業人士使用。
Volunteers came from all walks of life to help.
志工來自各行各業前來幫忙。

items.pos: phr. 在架子上整理物品
items.colloc: neatly arrange items on the shelf 整齊地擺放架上物品 | arrange items on the shelf by size 依大小排列物品
items.distinct: stock the shelf 上架商品 | organize the shelf 組織貨架
ex: The clerk is busy arranging items on the shelf.
店員正忙著整理架上的物品。
Please arrange items on the shelf by category.
請依照類別將架上物品整理好。
It took an hour to arrange items on the shelf.
花了一個小時來整理架上的物品。

items.pos: phr. 按照要求；依照指示
items.colloc: submit as requested 按要求提交 | as requested by the manager 依照經理要求
items.distinct: as required 按照規定 | as per instructions 根據指示
ex: I have submitted the files as requested.
我已按照要求提交了檔案。
The report was modified as requested by the client.
報告已根據客戶要求進行了修改。
We have processed the order as requested.
我們已按照指示處理該訂單。

items.colloc: work for hours at a stretch 連續工作數小時 | talk for an hour at a stretch 連續說一小時
items.distinct: continuously 連續地 | at once 立刻
ex: He can work for six hours at a stretch.
他可以連續工作六個小時。
We held meetings all day at a stretch.
我們一整天都在連續開會。
She studied for four hours at a stretch.
她連續讀了四個小時的書。

items.pos: phr. 在最後一刻；臨近截止前
items.zh: 在最後一刻；臨近截止前
items.colloc: change at the last minute 最後一刻更改 | arrive at the last minute 最後一刻抵達
items.distinct: in the final moment 在最後時刻 | late 遲到
ex: The meeting was canceled at the last minute.
會議在最後一刻被取消了。
He submitted his proposal at the last minute.
他在最後一刻提交了提案。
Avoid making decisions at the last minute.
避免在最後一刻才做決定。
